item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"claim_1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"`COPRO.compile` reads the existing `prefix` from the final field's `json_schema_extra` and applies the best candidate by assigning a new signature that changes both the instructions and that field's `prefix`.","span_ids":["e1","e2"]},{"claim_id":"claim_2","claim_type":"core","weight":15,"statement":"`DspyAdapter.build_program` for GEPA only reassigns matching predictors with `pred.signature.with_instructions(candidate[name])`; it does not perform a corresponding field-prefix update there.","span_ids":["e3"]},{"claim_id":"claim_3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"`ChatAdapter.format_task_description` renders the prompt objective directly from `signature.instructions`, so instruction mutations still affect the built prompt text.","span_ids":["e4"]},{"claim_id":"claim_4","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"In the shown `ChatAdapter` field-description and field-structure builders, visible field text is assembled from field names plus helper-derived description/type information (`get_field_description_string` and `translate_field_type`); `get_field_description_string` uses annotations, `desc`, custom type descriptions, and constraints rather than any `prefix`. A prefix-only mutation therefore is not surfaced in those rendered prompt sections.","span_ids":["e5","e6"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"e1","path":"dspy/teleprompt/copro_optimizer.py","start_line":155,"end_line":157},{"span_id":"e2","path":"dspy/teleprompt/copro_optimizer.py","start_line":261,"end_line":268},{"span_id":"e3","path":"dspy/teleprompt/gepa/gepa_utils.py","start_line":136,"end_line":142},{"span_id":"e4","path":"dspy/adapters/chat_adapter.py","start_line":139,"end_line":142},{"span_id":"e5","path":"dspy/adapters/chat_adapter.py","start_line":111,"end_line":137},{"span_id":"e6","path":"dspy/adapters/utils.py","start_line":225,"end_line":242}]}
